## Project Overview

This is a React TypeScript portfolio website built with Vite. The project uses modern web development practices and focuses on clean, responsive design.

## Tech Stack

- React 19
- TypeScript
- Vite
- CSS3 (Custom properties and modern features)
- ESLint for code quality

## Code Style Guidelines

- Use functional components with hooks
- Prefer TypeScript interfaces for type definitions
- Use CSS custom properties for theming
- Follow React best practices for component composition
- Use semantic HTML elements for accessibility
- Implement responsive design patterns

## Component Structure

- Keep components small and focused on single responsibility
- Use proper TypeScript typing for all props and state
- Implement proper error boundaries where necessary
- Use CSS modules or styled components for component-specific styles
